preconditions.description: Grid dimensions h and w are at least 2, and the number of days q is at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == w and all(c in '.#' for c in row) for row in grid_rows)
preconditions.description: The grid consists of h rows, each of length w, containing only '.' (allowed) or '#' (permanently blocked).
The start cell (0,0) and end cell (h-1, w-1) are not permanently blocked.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 10 for k in daily_block_counts)
preconditions.description: For each day, the number of temporarily blocked cells k is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= r <= h and 1 <= c <= w for r, c in day_blocks) and len(set(day_blocks)) == len(day_blocks) for day_blocks in all_day_blocks)
preconditions.description: For each day, all blocked cells have valid coordinates within the grid, and the list of blocked cells contains no duplicates.

preconditions.expression: all((r-1, c-1) not in [(0,0), (h-1, w-1)] and grid_rows[r-1][c-1] == '.' for day_blocks in all_day_blocks for r, c in day_blocks)
preconditions.description: Temporarily blocked cells are never the start or end cell, and are never permanently blocked.
It is guaranteed that the grid with no temporary blocks allows a valid round trip (start to end and back without revisiting cells except start).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each day.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['YES', 'NO'] for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((has_valid_round_trip(grid_rows, h, w, day_blocks) and line == 'YES') or (not has_valid_round_trip(grid_rows, h, w, day_blocks) and line == 'NO') for day_blocks, line in zip(all_day_blocks, stdout_lines))
postconditions.description: For each day, the output is 'YES' if and only if there exists a path from (0,0) to (h-1, w-1) and a return path from (h-1, w-1) to (0,0) such that the two paths are internally vertex-disjoint (no cell is visited twice except the start/end cell which is visited at the beginning and end of the round trip).
